'''Alois Fürstner''' (born 23 July 1962) is an Austrian [[chemist]]. He is director of [[Organometallic chemistry|Organometallic Chemistry]] at the [[Max Planck Institute for Coal Research]] in [[Mülheim]], Germany.<ref name="KoFo">{{cite web | title=Organometallic Chemistry | website=Max-Planck-Institut für Kohlenforschung | url=http://www.kofo.mpg.de/en/research/organometallic-chemistry | access-date=5 November 2018}}</ref>

He has been awarded the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize|Leibniz Prize]] (1999),<ref name="KoFo"/> the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]]'s [[Centenary Prize]] (2004),<ref name="RSC">{{cite web|title=RSC Centenary Prizes|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CentenaryPrizes/ |publisher=[[Royal Society of Chemistry]]|accessdate=5 November 2018|language=en}}</ref> the [[Heinrich Wieland Prize]] (2006),<ref name="KoFo"/> the [[Otto Bayer Award]] (2006),<ref name="KoFo"/> the Janssen Prize for Creativity in Organic Synthesis (2008),<ref name="Janssen">{{cite web | title=PROF. A. Fürstner | website=www.janssenpharmaceuticaprize.com | date=29 June 2016 | url=http://www.janssenprizeorganicsynthesis.com/prof-Furstner.html | access-date=5 November 2018}}</ref> the {{ill|Karl Ziegler Prize|de|Karl-Ziegler-Preis}} (2013),<ref name="Ziegler">{{cite web | title=Karl-Ziegler-Stiftung | trans-title=Karl Ziegler Foundation | website=Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker e.V. | url=https://www.gdch.de/gdch/stiftungen/ziegler-stiftung.html | language=de | access-date=5 November 2018}}</ref> and the [[Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize]] (2013).<ref name="Gay-Lussac Humboldt">{{cite web | title=Attribution du Prix Gay-Lussac Humboldt 2013 | trans-title=Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize 2013 | website=Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur, de la Recherche et de l'Innovation | url=//www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid59085/attribution-du-prix-gay-lussac-humboldt-2013.html | language=fr | access-date=5 November 2018}}</ref> He was elected a member of the [[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]] in 2002.<ref name="Leopoldina 2018">{{cite web | title=List of Members | website=Leopoldina | date=4 June 2018 | url=http://www.leopoldina.org/en/members/list-of-members/member/899/ | access-date=5 November 2018}}</ref>
